messages:
Elena (CS): Team, SparkMart POC is blocked: dedicated GPU pool provisioning in europe-north1 fails with IP allocation + zone affinity errors. Demo in <24h. Can we swarm?
Rex (Sales): Customer needs clear path: can we get them a demo environment today? They asked about pricing if we use a managed pool vs their account.
Nora (Eng Platform): Share the prov logs please. Quick checks: subnet size, secondary ranges, and project GPU quota.
Elena (CS): Here are the errors from the UI:
```
Provisioner: allocation_error: NoAvailableAddresses: subnet 10.128.16.0/28 -> available=0
Cause: ReservationViolation: requestedZones=[europe-north1-a,europe-north1-b] not satisfiable
QuotaCheck: GPU_QUOTA(project=sparkmart-prod)=0 in europe-north1
request_id: prov-1b7e
```
Elena (CS): Customer says infra carved only /28 for pods and didn't request GPU quota.
Ben (Infra): Two simultaneous blockers: subnet tiny (/28) and GPU quota at 0. Fastest demo path: (A) transient managed tenancy in same region (if provider capacity) or (B) expand their subnet + request quota (slower).
Clara (Security): If we use managed tenancy, we need CMK access or customer-provided key in that region, and a short DPA. Also need audit log endpoint for their SIEM.
Nora (Eng Platform): Quick workaround: spin a transient pool in eu-west1 (nearby) and route traffic; will need latency signoff. Also check if SKU supports region-flex allocation to relax zone affinity.
Rex (Sales): Customer prefers europe-north1 for latency. Offer them managed tenancy in-region for demo and promise migration runbook if quotas come through. Need to answer pricing: transient managed pool = on-demand + ops surcharge; reserved discount applies only if reservation is created under customer account before discounting.
infra-bot: Provision attempt #2 failed at 11:12 UTC: insufficient_ips (prov-1b7e). Logs: https://ci.internal/prov/1b7e
Ben (Infra): Action items: 
- (Ben) check managed tenancy capacity in europe-north1 and prepare static egress IPs (ETA 20m)
- (Nora) prepare migration/canary runbook and region-flex SKU options (ETA 40m)
- (Clara) draft shortest CMK grant snippet and DPA checklist (ETA 60m)
- (Elena) send subnet expansion + quota request templates to customer (ETA 10m)
Elena (CS): Sent quota + subnet templates. Customer ok with managed tenancy for the demo if we guarantee static egress and no data leaves EU.
Clara (Security): For CMK: they can either grant our service-account roles on their key in europe-north1 or provide a new key in our account with restricted policy. I'll attach sample policy.
Ben (Infra): Managed tenancy availability: confirmed. Static egress IPs pending allocation. If they accept, we can provision a pool and hand over NAT IPs for allowlist.
Nora (Eng Platform): Pricing reminder: if they convert to reserved later and create the reservation under their account within 14 days, finance may consider prorating transient charges. Tagging billing.
Rex (Sales): I'll draft the short note for the customer: demo plan, pricing for transient pool, and migration guarantee.
Elena (CS): Closing loop: last update 11:30 UTC  managed tenancy provisioning started; customer to test at 12:00 UTC. Will update on test outcome or if they push for subnet changes.
